title: Towards Measuring and Modeling “Culture” in LLMs: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and taxonomy creation analyzing how 90+ papers use demographic and semantic proxies (e.g., values, food, norms) alongside black-box probing methods (discriminative and generative) to measure cultural representation and bias in LLMs.

Surveying studies that contrast model performance and responses on region-specific datasets to reveal disparities and biases toward dominant Western/American cultures compared to non-Western contexts.
Reviewing papers that evaluate linguistic proxies of culture, contrasting LLM performance, reasoning, and cultural awareness on English versus non-English and multilingual datasets.

Surveying persona-driven and prompt-based studies that assess stereotyping and discriminatory behaviors associated with varying demographic attributes and their intersection with cultural conditioning.
